title: Jesus... Two Years Of Praying The Same Prayer 😔
topic: he has prayed the same prayer every night for two years, nothing has changed, and he started to wonder if it even reaches God

bible.text: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I've prayed the same prayer for two years. Still nothing. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Every night. Same words. I'm starting to wonder if they're even reaching You.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: They reached Me the first night. And every night since. Nothing you prayed was lost.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why does heaven feel quiet? Other people get answers in weeks.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Quiet isn't silence. Some answers grow slow because what they're becoming is bigger than the ask.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I'm not late. Stay in the waiting with Me. I'm good to those who seek Me.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone whose prayer is still open.
